description: Round/cylindrical deep-drawn bearing cup with a rim and central bore.

decision.defect_when: The expected central through-hole is absent and the center is solid/blind.
decision.clear_when: A genuine central through-hole is visibly present.
decision.review_when: Perspective, glare or occlusion prevents deciding whether the center is a through-hole.
ignore: Dark bore interior when the hole opening is clearly present.
decision.localization: Tight box around the central bore/expected punch location.

decision.check: Trace the central bore opening and account for perspective before judging shape.
decision.defect_when: The bore contour is locally pinched, deformed or irregular beyond a smooth perspective ellipse.
decision.clear_when: The bore is a smooth circle head-on or a smooth perspective ellipse when tilted.
decision.review_when: The bore contour is too obscured to distinguish perspective from deformation.
ignore: Bore interior shading when the opening contour is intact.
decision.localization: Tight box around the deformed portion of the central bore.
